title: Contains Duplicate
statement: Given a list `nums`, return `true` if any value appears at least twice, otherwise return `false`.

predict_steps.prompt: Scanning nums=[1,2,3,1], after seeing indices 0..2, what values are in the seen set?
predict_steps.hint: Every new value is added until a repeat.

predict_steps.prompt: When you reach the last 1, what do you return?

viva.question: What is the time cost of detecting a duplicate with a hash set?
expected_points: one linear scan over the array is enough
each membership test is amortized constant time
extra space grows with the number of distinct values
you can stop at the first clash instead of finishing the array

viva.question: What breaks for an empty list or a single-element list?
expected_points: the set never sees a collision
length under two is an immediate no-duplicate case

viva.question: Why does finding a value already in the set prove a duplicate immediately?
expected_points: the set stores every value already visited
a second sighting means the multiset is not unique
later elements cannot undo an earlier clash
the invariant is that the set equals the unique prefix so far
